# Tivi Home

> Android TV home screen (launcher) and its design system: glassmorphism UI on mesh gradient backgrounds, big light
> clock, month calendar with Vietnamese lunar dates, Open-Meteo weather, editable dock, child lock with PIN.
> Remote-controlled, Vietnamese UI, fixed 960x540 dp stage.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an AI should use this repository (design vs. build/install)
- [README.md](README.md): features, install guide, prompts

- [design/reference/home.html](design/reference/home.html): home screen reference

- [design/PROMPT.md](design/PROMPT.md): ready-made prompts
